entries.title: Proverbs 9:1
segments:
CHAP. IX. 
 
  Christ, under the name of wisdom invites us to his entertainment,   ver. 1-6.   Foretells the different successes of his invitation, ver. 7-9.   Shews the fruit of fearing God, ver. 10-12.   Sin, in the person of a foolish woman invites us to her entertainment,   ver. 13-17.   Which ends in destruction, ver. 18 
 
  V. 1. Her house-For the reception of her guests.  Seven-Many pillars; whereby is intimated the beauty and stability of the church. Pillars-Prophets, and apostles, and ministers.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:2
segments: V. 2. Killed-Made provision for the guests.  Mingled-With water, as they used to do in those hot countries.  Furnished-With all necessaries, and now waits for the guests.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:3
segments: V. 3. Maidens-Her servants to invite the guests, ministers of the word whom he calls maidens for the decency of the parable; for wisdom being compared to a great princess, was fit to be attended upon by maidens. Highest places-From such high seats as those from which judges delivered their sentences, and officers made proclamations.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:7
segments: V. 7. A former-He shews whom he meant by the foolish, ver.
, even scorners and wicked men, and presses his last advice of forsaking them because there was no good, but hurt to be got from them.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:8
segments: V. 8. A scorner-An obstinate and incorrigible sinner.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:12
segments: V. 12. For thyself-Thou dost not profit me but thyself.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:14
segments: V. 14. At the door-Watching for occasions of sin.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:15
segments: V. 15. Go right-Who are going innocently about their business.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:16
segments: V. 16. Simple-This title is not given them by her, but by Solomon.

entries.title: Proverbs 9:17
segments: V. 17. Sweet-From the difficulty of obtaining them; and because the very prohibition renders them more grateful to corrupt nature.
